options.reference_text: CONCORD RETURNED TO ITS PLACE AMIDST THE TENTS

requests.text: The museum opened early on Saturday so that visitors could watch the restoration team at work. Behind a glass screen, two specialists carefully cleaned an old map of the coast. A guide explained how they used photographs and written records to identify the faded names of villages. Outside, children gathered around a model ship and asked how sailors found their way before satellite navigation. At noon, the team covered the map and invited everyone upstairs to see the finished exhibition.
